chapter: Nola band, day job and nightclub work
title: After the Supreme Band: Ernest Johnson and dating the early bands
summary: Bands drifted apart; he joined Ernest Johnson's band, and they try to date the Supreme Band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: And what happened with that band then, the last few years?

Well, you know, they separate one by one, somebody leave, and you know, you left, you who tried to keep the thing in mind, you left in the suit. And you had to start hustling some more. And you could always hustle a few, you know.
What band did you build after that?
Well, I went with a fellow by the name of Ernest Johnson, we used to call him, Doug Ernest.
Yeah. I don't know if you know about it. I guess you know about that. But he died up in Bowley. Yeah. Oh yeah. You know Dave Bailey?
Dave Bailey, yeah, he's a drummer.
Yeah, he told me about it. Yeah, he, he, Dave Bailey, last I saw him, he was doing janitorial work in Sierra Mill Hospital. Yeah.
Well, I don't talk to him too often. He's not too well, but his landlord, I know his landlord.
What about this first band, you said the Supreme Band, what year was that you think?
I don't think, I think it was around 1914, I don't know. Oh, it was that early?
Before the war anyway, huh? Yeah, yeah.
Well, during, I might say during the war, you know, around, between 1940, 70. I see, it was really early.
